title: Quick Fried Vietnamese Chicken Sizzling Crepe
description: A spicy and comforting Vietnamese dish featuring cardamom, served in a crispy banh xeo crepe. This recipe is a healthier twist on the classic, using low-sodium ingredients and a moderate amount of oil.
instructions: Soak the bean sprouts and shredded carrots in water for at least 30 minutes.
Drain the bean sprouts and carrots, and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the chicken breasts, corn flour, water, coconut milk, cardamom, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken mixture to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, breaking up the meat with a spatula as it cooks.
Add the bean sprouts and carrots to the skillet and continue cooking for another 2-3 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Add the fish sauce and continue cooking for 1 minute.
Transfer the mixture to a small bowl, and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil and the chopped cilantro.
Brush the crepe pan or skillet with the oil and cook over medium heat for 1-2 minutes on each side, until the crepe is crispy and golden brown.
Place the crepe on a flat surface, and fill with the chicken and vegetable mixture.
Fold the crepe in half over the filling, and serve hot.
